species: As the datasets were from clinical samples, we added human proteins and common contaminants to the COVID-19 protein sequence database.
tissue: nasopharyngeal swab, gargling sample, nasal swab, upper respiratory tract, BALF, urine

For our timeline and geographical evaluation of the COVID-19 infection, we chose five nasopharyngeal swab datasets (PXD019686, PXD023016, PXD034582 (August, September, and January)); a gargling sample dataset (PXD019423); a nasal swab (PXD020394); an upper respiratory tract sample (PXD021328); a BALF sample (PXD022085) and a urine sample (PXD024967), all collected at different times and locations.
disease_state: All of the mentioned peptides were present in clinical samples obtained from COVID-19-positive patients collected at different times and geographical locations
sample_source: All of the mentioned peptides were present in clinical samples obtained from COVID-19-positive patients collected at different times and geographical locations
strain: As a result of this evaluation, we identified six peptides that belong to the variants Gamma, Delta, and Omicron.
